blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense team is set to present three government officials as witnesses on Friday, Day 45 of her impeachment trial, to shed light on the registration, product approvals and business dealings of Cale88 Foods Corp., a banana chips manufacturer linked to her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio. The company drew scrutiny during the prosecution’s presentation after Anti-Money Laundering Council Executive Director Ronel Buenaventura testified that it received around P319 million in remittances from China, with prosecutors and senator-judges raising questions about the transactions and the company’s initial capital. /dp READ: Highlights: Day 44 of Sara Duterte […]...
